why: No price-history backtest exists. The module began accumulating its own index history at first export; until a forward window closes there is no out-of-sample test to run, and none is claimed.

pre_registration.target: forward 90-day percent change in the published Card Index for each watchlist card
pre_registration.candidate: the gap (talent percentile minus market percentile) at t0
baselines: momentum carry (the card's own prior-window trend)
pre_registration.metric: Spearman rho of gap vs forward return, plus decile spread
pre_registration.ship_bar: beat BOTH baselines out of sample on rho, with the zero-information control excluded from the bootstrap CI, on at least 3 of 4 forward windows
pre_registration.earliest_possible_run: two full non-overlapping forward windows after the first export with n_priced >= 30
pre_registration.if_it_fails: the ledger records the refusal and the page keeps the screen label; the index itself is descriptive and survives a failed signal gate

notes: Thresholds BUY_GAP=+20 / FADE_GAP=-20 are display conventions, not fitted values, and must be refit or dropped if this gate ever runs.
